exit 0
--- stdout
Store one admission limit. The class name is lowercase letters, digits and
dashes. An identical definition is a successful no-op; replacing a different
one requires --replace and --reason. A new --max-concurrent also reaches
commands already queued for the class within about 10 s; commands already
holding a slot keep it. Write a substring that starts with a dash as
--match=<substring>.
Example:
liza admission-limit set db-suite --max-concurrent 2 --match=--decision-model-db
Usage:
liza admission-limit set <class> --max-concurrent <n> --match <substring> [--match <substring>...] [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for set
--json output result as structured JSON
--match stringArray Substring that puts a command in the class (repeatable)
--max-concurrent int How many commands of the class may execute at once
--reason string Reason for the change
--replace Replace a different existing definition (requires --reason)
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
